records.source: Dear @,^You've been such a help around town since you moved here... everyone keeps telling me all the wonderful things you've done for them! Please accept this thank-you prize. ^   -Mayor%item money 2500 2501 %%[#]Thank-you From Lewis
records.translation: 親愛的 @：^自從搬來這裡，你一直熱心幫助鎮上的人……每個人都不停告訴我，你為他們做了多少好事！請收下這份謝禮。^   ——鎮長%item money 2500 2501 %%[#]路易斯的謝禮

records.source: @,^I am pleased to announce that you've been chosen as "Neighbor of the year"! That comes with a 10,000g prize! Congratulations! Everyone in town wants to say 'thanks' for all you've done. ^   -Mayor%item money 10000 10001 %%[#]Neighbor Of The Year
records.translation: @：^我很高興宣布你獲選為「年度最佳鄰居」！另附 10,000g 獎金！恭喜！鎮上每個人都想感謝你所做的一切。^   ——鎮長%item money 10000 10001 %%[#]年度最佳鄰居

records.source: Dear @,^ Your angling skills surpass even my ol' Pappy's... I'm impressed. ^ This stardrop's been passed down from Willy Sr. to Willy Jr. for... oh, heck. Prob'ly a thousand years.^Seein' as I don't have any kids... I want you to have it.^^ -Willy   ^  %item id (O)434 1 %%[#]Willy's Family Heirloom
records.translation: 親愛的 @：^你的釣魚技術甚至超越了我家老爸……真了不起。^這顆星之果實從老威利傳給小威利，已經……唉呀，大概有一千年了吧。^既然我沒有孩子……就把它交給你。^^ ——威利   ^  %item id (O)434 1 %%[#]威利的傳家寶

records.source: Dear @ and spouse,^Congratulations! Your adoption application has been approved.^We're working hard to choose the perfect baby to match your profile.^Your new family member will arrive in 2 weeks.^^-Ferngill Adoption Agency[#]Adoption Notice
records.translation: 親愛的 @ 與配偶：^恭喜！你們的領養申請已獲批准。^我們正在努力挑選最符合你們家庭資料的寶寶。^新的家庭成員將在兩週後到來。^^——芬吉爾領養機構[#]領養通知

records.source: Secret Message: If you can reach the bottom of the mines one more time, a secret awaits you. Be careful, the mines have become more dangerous.[#]Secret Message
records.translation: 祕密訊息：如果能再次抵達礦井底層，就會有一項祕密等著你。小心，礦井已經變得更加危險。[#]祕密訊息

records.source: Dear neighbor,^I hope you are feeling settled in your new home. I am writing to let you know that Pierre's store is now selling fertilizers! Why don't you swing by and see if you can afford a few dozen boxes or so?  ^   -Pierre[#]Pierre's Fertilizers
records.translation: 親愛的鄰居：^希望你已經開始適應新家。寫信是想通知你，皮埃爾雜貨店現在開始販售肥料了！何不順道來看看，是否買得起幾十盒呢？  ^   ——皮埃爾[#]皮埃爾的肥料

records.source: Dear @,^I am now selling higher quality fertilizers, as well as new crop selections! See you soon. ^   -Pierre[#]Pierre's High Quality Fertilizers
records.translation: 親愛的 @：^我現在開始販售更高品質的肥料，還有全新的作物選擇！期待很快見到你。^   ——皮埃爾[#]皮埃爾的高品質肥料

records.source: Hi @.^One of these days you should come to my room after dark... Maybe around 8pm. ^I want to show you something. ^   -Abby[#]Abby's Note
records.translation: 嗨，@。^改天晚上天黑後來我的房間吧……大概八點左右。^我想給你看一樣東西。^   ——阿比[#]阿比的便條

records.source: Meet me in the bath house after dark. ^   -Penny[#]Penny's Note
records.translation: 天黑後到澡堂來找我。^   ——潘妮[#]潘妮的便條

records.source: Dear @,^^Thank you for purchasing a coop upgrade! In addition to doubling the capacity of your coop, I've taken the liberty of installing an incubator. ^To use the incubator, simply place an egg inside. If you have space left in your coop, the egg will hatch in several days!^^As always, thanks for your business.^-Robin[#]About The Incubator
records.translation: 親愛的 @：^^感謝購買雞舍升級服務！除了將雞舍容量加倍，我還擅自替你安裝了一座孵化器。^只要把蛋放進去就能使用孵化器。如果雞舍還有空位，蛋會在幾天後孵化！^^一如往常，感謝惠顧。^——羅賓[#]關於孵化器

records.source: Hi.^^Me sell hats. Okay, poke?^^Come to old old old haus, poke. Bring coines.^^-hat mouse[#]Hiyo, Poke
records.translation: 嗨。^^俺賣帽帽。好嗎，夥伴？^^來老老老屋，夥伴。帶錢錢。^^——帽子老鼠[#]嘿喲，夥伴

records.source: Congratulations!!^^You beat 'Journey Of The Prairie King', and were randomly selected in our exclusive winner's sweepstakes! ^You've won a Prairie King Arcade System of your very own!^Now you can enjoy 'Journey Of The Prairie King' from the comfort of your own home.^^You deserve it!^-Prairie King Development Team %item id (BC)141 %%[#]P.K. Congratulations!
records.translation: 恭喜！！^^你成功破關「草原王之旅」，並在獨家舉辦的贏家抽獎中幸運中選！^你贏得了一台專屬於自己的草原王街機！^現在待在舒適的家中，就能盡情享受「草原王之旅」。^^這是你應得的！^——草原王開發團隊 %item id (BC)141 %%[#]草原王恭喜你！

records.source: Congratulations!!^^You beat all the levels in 'JunimoKart'... you're actually the first person in the entire Ferngill Republic to do so!^Your prize: a home version of Junimo Kart!^^Have fun!^-Junimo Kart Development Team %item id (BC)159 %%[#]Junimo Kart Success!
records.translation: 恭喜！！^^你通過了「祝尼魔賽車」的所有關卡……你竟然是整個芬吉爾共和國第一個辦到的人！^你的獎品：家用版祝尼魔賽車！^^玩得開心！^——祝尼魔賽車開發團隊 %item id (BC)159 %%[#]祝尼魔賽車挑戰成功！

records.source: @,^I have great news... my novel is finished!! I'm giving a public reading this afternoon at the library. Hope to see you there! ^   -Elliott[#]Elliott's Reading
records.translation: @：^有個好消息……我的小說完成了！！今天下午會在圖書館舉行公開朗讀會。希望到時能見到你！^   ——艾利歐特[#]艾利歐特的朗讀會

records.source: Meet me at the docks on a sunny morning. I've got something in mind. ^   -Elliott[#]Elliott's Note
records.translation: 找個晴朗的早晨到碼頭來見我。我有個想法。^   ——艾利歐特[#]艾利歐特的便條

records.source: @,^I have a surprise for you. Meet me by the railroad tracks. ^   -Harvey[#]Harvey's Surprise
records.translation: @：^我準備了一份驚喜給你。到鐵軌旁來見我。^   ——哈維[#]哈維的驚喜

records.source: @,^meet me in front of my house tonight after dark. ^   -Sam[#]Sam's Note
records.translation: @：^今晚天黑後到我家門口來見我。^   ——山姆[#]山姆的便條

records.source: @,^meet me at the saloon tonight after dark. ^   -Alex[#]Alex' Invitation
records.translation: @：^今晚天黑後到酒館來見我。^   ——亞歷克斯[#]亞歷克斯的邀請

records.source: @,^^In the future, I'd appreciate it very much if you refrained from placing my PRIVATE belongings in town for all to see!^^I'm very displeased!^^Take this money and never speak of my 'project' to anyone.%item money 750 751 %%[#]Lewis' Angry Letter
records.translation: @：^^今後，請不要再把我的私人財物擺在鎮上供所有人觀看，不勝感激！^^我非常不滿！^^拿走這些錢，而且永遠別向任何人提起我的「計畫」。%item money 750 751 %%[#]路易斯的憤怒信件

records.source: @,^I've got a new item in stock... It's called the "Auto-Grabber".^^This thing can milk your cows and goats, shear your sheep, gather eggs, and pluck your wooly rabbits... all on its own!^^It's considered a 'luxury item', so I'm charging 25,000g.^^    -Marnie[#]Auto-Grabber Notice
records.translation: @：^我進了一款新商品……名叫「自動採集器」。^^這東西完全自動就能替乳牛和山羊擠奶、替綿羊剪毛、收集蛋，還能採集長毛兔的兔毛！^^它被視為「奢侈品」，所以定價是 25,000g。^^    ——瑪妮[#]自動採集器通知

records.source: @,^I have this crazy new idea that I want to involve you in... It's called "Clothing Therapy".^^Please come to the Mayor's house today to see what it's all about.^^ Love, Emily[#]Emily's Idea
records.translation: @：^我有個異想天開的新點子，想邀請你一起參與……它叫「服裝療法」。^^請在今天到鎮長家來，看看這究竟是怎麼回事。^^愛你的艾蜜莉[#]艾蜜莉的點子

records.source: @,^Let's go camping! ^^ Meet me in the secret woods after 10pm.^^ Love, Emily[#]Emily's Invitation
records.translation: @：^一起去露營吧！^^晚上十點後到祕密森林來見我。^^愛你的艾蜜莉[#]艾蜜莉的邀請

records.source: Thanks for joining me last night... I had a great time.^I'm actually glad that bear showed up!^^See you soon^^  Love, Emily[#]Emily's Note
records.translation: 謝謝你昨晚陪我……我玩得非常開心。^其實我很高興那隻熊出現了！^^待會兒見^^  愛你的艾蜜莉[#]艾蜜莉的便條

records.source: Dear @,^Someone dropped your tools into the lost and found bin last night.^^Stop by the mayor's office to pick them up. ^^  -Mayor Lewis[#]Lost Tools
records.translation: 親愛的 @：^昨晚有人把你的工具放進失物招領箱。^^請到鎮長辦公室領回。^^  ——路易斯鎮長[#]遺失的工具

records.source: I've got some new items in stock...^A deluxe fishing pole and some bait that you can attach to it!^You can use bait to make fish bite faster. Hope to see you soon! ^   -Willy[#]Willy's New Items
records.translation: 我進了一些新商品……^一根高級釣竿，還有可以裝在上面的魚餌！^使用魚餌能讓魚更快上鉤。希望很快見到你！^   ——威利[#]威利的新商品

records.source: Come by the shop and check out the new rods I'm selling.^They're the best money can buy... and you can customize them with different kinds of tackle!^Hope to see you soon! ^   -Willy[#]Willy's New Items #2
records.translation: 來店裡看看我新推出的釣竿吧。^這是花錢能買到的頂級貨……而且可以搭配各種不同的釣具！^希望很快見到你！^   ——威利[#]威利的新商品 #2

records.source: My sources tell me you've been poking around inside the old community center.^Why don't you pay me a visit?^My chambers are west of the forest lake, in the stone tower. I may have information concerning your... 'rat problem'.^   -M. Rasmodius, Wizard %item quest 1 true %%[#]Wizard's Summons
records.translation: 我的消息來源告訴我，你一直在探索那座老舊社區中心。^何不來拜訪我？^我的居所位於森林湖泊西側的石塔。我也許掌握著與你的……「老鼠問題」有關的資訊。^   ——法師 M・拉斯莫迪斯 %item quest 1 true %%[#]法師的召喚

records.source: Dear @,^I would like to give you some information about an upcoming event: the Feast of the Winter Star. It's a time for the community to come together and think back on all the good fortune we've had this year.^A favorite tradition is the "secret gift exchange", where everyone in town is randomly assigned to someone else. On the day of the festival, everyone brings a gift for their secret friend and surprises them with something special!^This year, your secret friend is:^    %secretsanta ^Don't tell anyone! The feast will take place on the 25th from 9AM to 2PM at the town square. See you then! ^   -Mayor Lewis[#]Secret Gift-Giver
records.translation: 親愛的 @：^我想向你介紹即將舉行的活動：冬日星盛宴。屆時社區成員會齊聚一堂，回顧今年享有的種種幸運。^大家最喜愛的傳統是「祕密交換禮物」，鎮上每個人都會隨機抽到另一個人。節慶當天，大家會帶一份禮物給自己的祕密朋友，送上一份特別的驚喜！^今年你的祕密朋友是：^    %secretsanta ^別告訴任何人！盛宴將在二十五日上午九點到下午兩點於城鎮廣場舉行。到時見！^   ——路易斯鎮長[#]祕密送禮人

records.source: Dear @,^Everyone around town has been talking about your great generosity lately!^Apparently, packages have been appearing in people's houses containing items they posted about years ago on the community center bulletin! And the packages are all addressed from your farm!^Thanks for going out of your way to do something like that... all of us in town are delighted! ^   -Mayor Lewis[#]Bulletin Board Thank-you
records.translation: 親愛的 @：^最近鎮上每個人都在談論你的慷慨之舉！^據說大家的屋裡陸續出現包裹，裡面裝著他們多年前貼在社區中心公告欄上徵求的物品！而且所有包裹都寫著由你的農場寄出！^謝謝你特地為大家做這件事……鎮上所有人都非常開心！^   ——路易斯鎮長[#]公告欄感謝信

records.source: I see you've been exploring the old mine. You've got the adventurer's spirit, that much I can tell.^If you can slay 10 slimes, you'll have earned your place in my adventurer's guild. ^Be careful.    -Marlon %item quest 15 true %%[#]Quest To Slay Slimes
records.translation: 看來你一直在探索那座老礦井。我看得出來，你擁有冒險者的精神。^如果能消滅十隻史萊姆，就有資格加入我的冒險者公會。^務必小心。    ——馬龍 %item quest 15 true %%[#]消滅史萊姆的任務

records.source: I see you've entered the Skull Cavern. Well done.^I've got a better challenge for you, kid. Make it at least 25 levels deep. I've got a mountain of $ to send if you can do it.^  Your friend, Mr. Qi %item quest 20 %%[#]Qi's Challenge
records.translation: 看來你已經進入骷髏洞穴。做得好。^孩子，我準備了更高難度的挑戰給你。至少深入二十五層。只要辦得到，我就送你一大筆 $。^  你的朋友，齊先生 %item quest 20 %%[#]齊先生的挑戰

records.source: Robin here!^I know there's a lot of stone scattered around your farm.^If you have a surplus, you might consider having me build a well for you.^Wells can be placed all over your farm, and serve as convenient places to refill your watering can.^^Just swing by my shop with 75 stones and 1000g when you're ready for it.^-Robin[#]Build A Well
records.translation: 我是羅賓！^我知道你的農場四處散落著許多石頭。^如果手邊有多餘的石頭，不妨考慮請我替你蓋一口井。^水井可以設置在農場各處，讓你隨時方便地替澆水壺裝水。^^準備好後，只要帶著七十五顆石頭和 1000g 來我的商店。^——羅賓[#]建造水井

records.source: To our valued JojaMart customers:^Our team members have removed the landslide caused by our drilling operation near the mountain lake. I'd like to remind you that our drilling operation is entirely legal (pursuant to init. L61091, JojaCo Amendment). Responsible stewardship of the local environment is our top priority! ^^We apologize for any inconvenience this accident may have caused.^As always, we value your continued support and patronage!^^-Morris,^Joja Customer Satisfaction Representative[#]Joja Removed Landslide
records.translation: 致尊貴的 Joja 超市顧客：^本公司團隊已清除山中湖泊附近鑽探作業引發的坍方。謹此提醒，本公司的鑽探作業完全合法（依據 Joja 公司 L61091 號修正條款）。負責任地守護當地環境，是我們最優先的要務！^^對於本次事故造成的任何不便，我們深表歉意。^一如往常，我們十分重視各位持續的支持與惠顧！^^——莫里斯，^Joja 顧客滿意度專員[#]Joja 清除坍方

records.source: You did it.^ I'm very impressed.^ Enjoy your reward.^   -Qi. %item money 10000 %%[#]Qi Challenge Complete
records.translation: 你辦到了。^令我刮目相看。^好好享用獎勵。^   ——齊先生。%item money 10000 %%[#]齊先生的挑戰完成

records.source: Hello there,^Just got back from a fishing trip. You should come down to the beach some time.^I've got something for ya.^-Willy %item quest 13 true %%[#]Willy's Invitation
records.translation: 你好：^我剛釣魚回來。找個時間到海灘來吧。^有樣東西要給你。^——威利 %item quest 13 true %%[#]威利的邀請

records.source: Dear @,^Tomorrow we're holding the Egg Festival in the town square. ^^You should arrive between 9 AM and 2 PM if you'd like to attend.^You wouldn't want to miss the annual egg hunt!^  -Mayor Lewis[#]Egg Festival Notice
records.translation: 親愛的 @：^明天將在城鎮廣場舉辦彩蛋節。^^如果想參加，請在上午九點到下午兩點之間抵達。^可別錯過一年一度的尋蛋活動！^  ——路易斯鎮長[#]彩蛋節通知

records.source: Hello, dear...^^I know you're just getting started as a gardener, so I wanted to give you a little tip.^^Most crops only grow in one season. When summer arrives, your spring crops will all die out. So plan ahead!^^-Granny Evelyn[#]Evelyn's Tip
records.translation: 你好，親愛的……^^我知道你才剛開始務農，所以想給你一點小提示。^^大多數作物只能在一個季節生長。夏天到來後，春季作物就會全數枯萎。因此要事先規劃！^^——伊芙琳奶奶[#]伊芙琳的提示

records.source: Dear @,^Tomorrow we're all getting together for the Flower Dance.^^If you can find a partner, you might even want to participate in the dance yourself!^There's a little clearing beyond the forest west of town where we hold the dance. Arrive between 9 AM and 2 PM if you're interested.^  -Mayor Lewis[#]Flower Dance Notice
records.translation: 親愛的 @：^明天大家將齊聚一堂參加花舞節。^^如果能找到舞伴，也許你自己也會想加入舞會！^舞會會在城鎮西邊森林深處的一小片空地舉行。如果有興趣，請在上午九點到下午兩點之間抵達。^  ——路易斯鎮長[#]花舞節通知

records.source: Dear @,^Tomorrow we're all gathering at the beach for the annual Pelican Town Luau.^^The highlight of the event is the communal potluck. Make sure you bring something good to contribute!^The governor himself is attending the event, so make sure you're on your best behavior.^Come to the beach sometime between 9 AM and 2 PM.^   -Mayor Lewis[#]Luau Notice
records.translation: 親愛的 @：^明天大家將齊聚海灘，參加一年一度的鵜鶘鎮夏威夷宴會。^^活動的重頭戲是眾人共享的百樂餐。務必帶一樣好東西來分享！^州長本人也會出席，因此一定要拿出最佳表現。^請在上午九點到下午兩點之間前往海灘。^   ——路易斯鎮長[#]夏威夷宴會通知

records.source: Dear @,^Tonight at around 10 o'clock PM, a rare and beautiful event will take place.^^The moonlight jellies will be passing by Pelican Town on their long journey south for the winter.^^We're all gathering at the beach to watch. You don't want to miss this!^See you tonight,^ -Demetrius[#]Dance Of The Moonlight Jellies
records.translation: 親愛的 @：^今晚十點左右，將出現難得一見的美麗景象。^^月光水母會在前往南方過冬的漫長旅途中經過鵜鶘鎮。^^大家都會聚在海灘上觀賞。千萬別錯過！^今晚見，^ ——德米特里厄斯[#]月光水母之舞

records.source: Dear @,^One week from today, we are holding the Stardew Valley Fair in the town square!^It's the biggest event of the year, drawing people from all across the country to our humble town.^If you'd like, you can set up a grange display for the event. Just bring up to 9 items that best showcase your talents. You'll be judged on the quality and diversity of your display.^The fair starts at 9 AM... don't miss it!^   -Mayor Lewis[#]Stardew Valley Fair Notice
records.translation: 親愛的 @：^一週後，我們將在城鎮廣場舉辦星露谷展覽會！^這是全年最大的活動，會吸引全國各地的人來到我們這座樸實小鎮。^如果願意，你可以在活動中設置農產品展。只要帶來最多九件最能展現你才華的物品。評審將依照展品的品質與多樣性評分。^展覽會上午九點開始……千萬別錯過！^   ——路易斯鎮長[#]星露谷展覽會通知

records.source: Dear @,^I just want to remind you that the Stardew Valley Fair is happening tomorrow.^Don't forget to bring your 9 items for the grange display.^Remember, the fair starts at 9AM in the town square. See you there!^   -Mayor Lewis[#]Stardew Valley Fair Reminder
records.translation: 親愛的 @：^提醒你，星露谷展覽會將在明天舉行。^別忘了帶上農產品展要用的九件物品。^記住，展覽會上午九點在城鎮廣場開始。到時見！^   ——路易斯鎮長[#]星露谷展覽會提醒

records.source: Dear @,^Notice a chill in the air? It could just be the approach of winter...^Or it could be the tingle of a dark specter, here to help us celebrate tomorrow's festival... the Spirit's Eve.^Come to town at 10 PM if you'd like to participate.^  -Mayor Lewis[#]Spirit's Eve Notice
records.translation: 親愛的 @：^有沒有察覺空氣中的寒意？也許只是冬季將近……^也可能是黑暗幽靈帶來的戰慄感，牠將協助我們慶祝明天的節慶……萬靈節。^如果想參加，請在晚上十點來到鎮上。^  ——路易斯鎮長[#]萬靈節通知

records.source: Dear @,^Tomorrow we're all gathering in front of Marnie's house for the Festival of Ice.^^It's a celebration of winter... there'll be snowmen, ice sculptures, and an ice fishing competition!^Arrive between 9 AM and 2 PM if you'd like to participate.^  -Mayor Lewis[#]Festival Of Ice Notice
records.translation: 親愛的 @：^明天大家將聚集在瑪妮家門前參加冰雪節。^^這是一場冬季慶典……現場會有雪人、冰雕和冰釣比賽！^如果想參加，請在上午九點到下午兩點之間抵達。^  ——路易斯鎮長[#]冰雪節通知

records.source: Starting tomorrow, a traveling merchant fleet will dock at Pelican Town for the yearly night market.^^The market starts at 5pm, and will be in port for the next three days.^^Please visit the beach after 5pm to join the festivities. There's free coffee![#]Night Market Notice
records.translation: 從明天起，旅行商船隊將停靠鵜鶘鎮，舉辦一年一度的夜市。^^夜市下午五點開始，商船會在港口停留三天。^^請在下午五點後前往海灘參加慶典。現場還有免費咖啡！[#]夜市通知

records.source: MISSING:^I lost my favorite Axe! If you find it, please return ASAP. I'm having a tough time without it. There's 250g in it for whoever finds the thing.^   -Robin%item quest 100 %%[#]Robin Lost Her Axe
records.translation: 尋物：^我弄丟了最喜歡的斧頭！如果找到，請儘快歸還。沒有它實在很不方便。找到的人可獲得 250g 報酬。^   ——羅賓%item quest 100 %%[#]羅賓弄丟了斧頭

records.source: Farmer @-^I have a request for you. I need fresh cauliflower for a recipe I want to make. Could you bring me one?^   -Jodi%item quest 101 %%[#]Jodi Asks For Cauliflower
records.translation: 農夫 @：^有件事想拜託你。我想做一道料理，需要新鮮花椰菜。可以帶一顆給我嗎？^   ——喬迪%item quest 101 %%[#]喬迪想要花椰菜

records.source: @-^This is embarrassing... I lost my lucky purple shorts. I'm telling you because I think I can trust you.^If you find them, bring them back to me DISCREETLY. I'll pay well.^Thanks.^   -Mayor Lewis%item quest 102 %%[#]Lewis Asks For A Favor
records.translation: @：^這件事很難為情……我弄丟了幸運紫色短褲。因為相信你值得信賴，才把這件事告訴你。^如果找到了，請低調地拿回來給我。我會支付豐厚報酬。^謝謝。^   ——路易斯鎮長%item quest 102 %%[#]路易斯請你幫忙

records.source: Hey Kid,^My throat's about as dry as a desert bone. I'm real thirsty for a pale ale. You got one? Regular old beer won't do. I need a pale ale.^   -Pam%item quest 103 %%[#]Pam's Request
records.translation: 嘿，孩子：^我的喉嚨乾得像沙漠裡的骨頭。真想喝一杯淡啤酒。你有嗎？普通啤酒可不行，我需要的是淡啤酒。^   ——潘姆%item quest 103 %%[#]潘姆的請求

records.source: @-^I'm gathering data on the correlation between soil alkalinity and crop fructose levels. Long story short, I need a fresh melon from your farm. If you brought me one I'd be very grateful.^   -Demetrius%item quest 104 %%[#]Demetrius Asks For A Sample
records.translation: @：^我正在蒐集土壤鹼性與作物果糖含量之間關聯性的資料。長話短說，我需要一顆你農場出產的新鮮甜瓜。如果能帶一顆給我，我會非常感激。^   ——德米特里厄斯%item quest 104 %%[#]德米特里厄斯需要樣本

records.source: To Farmer @:^My knee's acting up again, and you know what helps? ^Rubbing the darn thing with hot pepper.^ Trouble is, my supply's run dry. If you've got one to spare I'd be much obliged.^   -George %item quest 105 %%[#]George Needs A Pepper
records.translation: 致農夫 @：^我的膝蓋老毛病又犯了，知道什麼東西管用嗎？^拿辣椒在這該死的膝蓋上揉。^麻煩的是，我手邊用完了。如果有多的可以給我，我會非常感激。^   ——喬治 %item quest 105 %%[#]喬治需要辣椒

records.source: Dear @,^I'd like to give my cows a special treat. They're such good girls and hungry, too. Could you bring me one bunch of amaranth? They love the stuff. ^Thanks, Dear.^   -Marnie %item quest 106 %%[#]Marnie's Request
records.translation: 親愛的 @：^我想給乳牛一份特別的點心。牠們都是乖女孩，而且肚子也餓了。可以帶一把莧菜給我嗎？牠們最愛吃了。^謝謝你，親愛的。^   ——瑪妮 %item quest 106 %%[#]瑪妮的請求

records.source: Hello,^It's blackberry season right now. The bushes are full of them. I want to pick some, but I lost my basket. Can you help?^   -Linus%item quest 107 %%[#]Linus Lost His Basket
records.translation: 你好：^現在正是黑莓的產季，灌木叢上結滿了果實。我想採一些，卻弄丟了籃子。可以幫忙嗎？^   ——萊納斯%item quest 107 %%[#]萊納斯弄丟了籃子

records.source: @-^I'd like to buy a pumpkin from you. My daughter and I want to carve a jack-o-lantern for the upcoming Spirit's Eve festival. ^   -Caroline%item quest 108 %%[#]Caroline's Request
records.translation: @：^我想向你買一顆南瓜。我和女兒想為即將到來的萬靈節雕刻南瓜燈。^   ——卡洛琳%item quest 108 %%[#]卡洛琳的請求

records.source: Hey, I've got a little challenge for you:^    Catch me a squid.^You can fish them from the ocean at night. They only show up in the winter, though.^   -Willy%item quest 109 %%[#]Willy's Challenge
records.translation: 嘿，有個小挑戰要交給你：^    替我釣一條魷魚。^晚上可以在海裡釣到，不過牠們只在冬季出現。^   ——威利%item quest 109 %%[#]威利的挑戰

records.source: I've got an unusual request. Could you keep this a secret?^ I want you to deliver an amethyst to Emily. It's her favorite stone. Tell her it's from me.^   -Clint %item quest 110 %%[#]Clint's Unusual Request
records.translation: 我有個不太尋常的請求。可以替我保密嗎？^我想請你把一顆紫水晶送給艾蜜莉。那是她最喜歡的寶石。告訴她是我送的。^   ——克林特 %item quest 110 %%[#]克林特的不尋常請求

records.source: @-^I am researching the forgotten art of shadow divination. I require an item known as 'Void Essence'. Bring it to me and you will be rewarded.^ -M. Rasmodius, Wizard %item quest 111 %%[#]Wizard's Request
records.translation: @：^我正在研究失傳的暗影占卜術。我需要一種名為「虛空精華」的物品。把它帶給我，就會獲得報酬。^ ——法師 M・拉斯莫迪斯 %item quest 111 %%[#]法師的請求

records.source: @,^Sorry to bother you again, but I need another favor.^I got a new hammer and I want to try it on a variety of metals.^Could you smelt an iron bar and bring it to me? ^Thanks.^ -Clint %item quest 112 %%[#]Clint's Request
records.translation: @：^很抱歉又來打擾，但我還需要你幫個忙。^我拿到一把新鐵鎚，想用各種金屬試試手感。^可以熔煉一根鐵錠帶給我嗎？^謝謝。^ ——克林特 %item quest 112 %%[#]克林特的請求

records.source: @-^How are you doing? Hope the winter hasn't been too hard on you.^Anyway, I'm writing to ask you for some hardwood. I need about ten pieces, if you've got it.^If not, no worries. Take Care!^  -Robin%item quest 113 %%[#]Robin's Request
records.translation: @：^最近過得如何？希望這個冬天沒有讓你太難熬。^總之，寫信是想向你要一些硬木。如果手邊有的話，我需要大約十塊。^沒有也別擔心。保重！^  ——羅賓%item quest 113 %%[#]羅賓的請求

records.source: Dear @-^I want to make fish stew, but I need an albacore! I know they're almost out of season... sorry about the short notice. Could you catch one for me?^   -Gus%item quest 114 %%[#]Gus Needs A Certain Fish
records.translation: 親愛的 @：^我想煮魚湯，但需要一條長鰭鮪魚！我知道牠們的產季快結束了……抱歉這麼臨時才開口。可以替我釣一條嗎？^   ——格斯%item quest 114 %%[#]格斯需要一種魚
